title: Set or clear one member's access rule for a scope (prepare)
description: Step 1 of 2 for change a member's access rule. Validates the arguments and returns a signed confirmation_hash plus a message to surface to the user. The user must reply with the literal word "confirm" before you call the matching -execute tool with the hash. Original action: Sets the level one organization member gets for one scope. A member rule applies to that person only and wins over their role rules and the default. The scope is the project (`resource: project` with the project id as `resource_id`, level `none`, `member` or `admin`), a whole tool (`resource: dashboard`, level `none`, `viewer`, `editor` or `manager`), one object (add `resource_id`), or one property (`resource: property_definition`, level `none`, `read` or `read_write`). A project level of `none` blocks access to the project and its resources. A null `access_level` removes the member's rule, so they fall back to their role rules or the default. An empty result means the rule is cleared. When several people need the same change, prefer a role rule. Read access-control-members-list with `member_id` first and tell the user the current and new level before asking for confirmation. Requires human typed confirmation.
